diagnostics.message:
This assignment reads n, so the compiler treats it as an update of n (a relative write, as in the deprecated old SC syntax).
Write it as n *= 10; n += 2 to say so. In one region it means the same.
It only matters when another region also writes n in the same tick: this assignment then runs after that write instead of conflicting with it.
